# Felix ERP prototype decisions

The supplied prototype specification governs this frontend demonstration. The repository SRS and Technical Architecture Specification describe the future production system. The static prototype does not replace or implement its Django/DRF, PostgreSQL or React/TypeScript architecture.

## CONFIRMED requirements

- Tenant is a customer company, never a factory. Felix has FLX-926 and FLX-927; Demo Apparel has an independent factory. Tenant-owned records carry `tenantId` and normalized relational IDs.
- Normal sessions resolve tenant through an active membership. Tenant/factory/section/SectionShift/own-assignment queries and mutation validation use central helpers. Platform directory access is separate; privileged tenant entry is visible and audited.
- WHAT permissions and WHERE membership scope remain separate. User accounts and employees remain separate.
- ProductionDay is canonical, uniquely identified by tenant + line + shift + date. HourlyOutput children supply totals; blank is `null`, while zero is a populated running hour. No independently entered daily total exists.
- ProductionEvent is the only lost-time source. Staffing links canonical attendance and supplements effective assignment responsibility.
- Efficiency uses present operators + helpers + manual staff. Efficiency hit rate is actual / planned × 100. Aggregation uses total earned SAH over available manpower hours. Zero/missing denominators display unavailable readings.
- One AttendanceRecord register supplies timesheets and scores. Corrections retain before/after values and reasons. Overnight clocks are handled by adding the next-day boundary.
- Production workflow is Draft → Pending → Approved or Pending → Returned → Draft. Appended workflow events retain actor, timestamp and reason. Approved records cannot be ordinarily edited or removed.
- Approval captures style SMV for historical calculations. New audit events snapshot organization context; access to a transfer's payload requires scope over both its before and after contexts.
- Default scores use efficiency 40, defect 20, first hour 20, QCO 10, attendance 10; components cap at 100. Missing components drop out and their weights renormalize. Factory targets override tenant defaults. Snapshots store config, targets, assignment context and component results.
- Buyer is normalized. Orders reference styles through order lines. Working calendars configure weekly non-working days and explicit exceptions. Capacity captures SMV, required minutes, operator count, efficiency and daily capacity assumptions.
- Stock on hand derives only from StockMovement. Posted receipts generate accepted-quantity movements. Reversal adds opposite entries and preserves the receipt history. Invoice balances derive from lines and payments.
- Important mutations create audit records. Histories have read/filter/detail interfaces, not arbitrary edit/delete controls. Dashboards present derived information and links to dedicated work pages.

## PROPOSED prototype choices

| Area                   | Demonstration choice                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Delivery               | Static directory independent of the production starter; no build dependencies or remote assets.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Fake database          | Normalized LocalStorage schema v1, SessionStorage identity, UUIDs for new records and stable readable seed IDs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Demo dates             | Seed dates relative to current browser date; a compact six-day attendance sample demonstrates the 90-day window.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Scope resolution       | A membership selects one explicit scope type. Factory, Section and SectionShift grants resolve downward; Own Assignment uses current active effective assignments. No implicit combination/precedence of conflicting grants is asserted as final policy.                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Permissions            | Configurable domain/action names and the six sample identities demonstrate a proposed matrix. No API permission contract or commercial role mapping is claimed approved.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Platform support       | A visible access-reason form, persistent privileged banner and audit entry. No real support elevation/token expiry or customer approval service.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Tenant provisioning    | A new tenant receives independent baseline configuration, roles and permissions, without copied operational/customer history.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Assignments            | Overlapping periods warn. Multiple supervisors remain permitted; ambiguous production is excluded from demo employee production components and labelled, rather than inventing proportional attribution. Attendance may still supply an available score component.                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Attendance denominator | Recorded applicable attendance days in the rolling window are the demo denominator. Missing attendance readings are omitted. Unrecorded days are not presumed absent. Leave and absence are excluded from present days.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Quality                | Optional simple defect/QCO readings and hourly damage only. Zero measured defects earn a capped 100 defect component; missing defects/QCO remain missing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| First hour             | Ordinal hour 1 is used, as required by the prototype prompt. A blank first hour does not substitute the first later running hour. This clarifies the TAS's illustrative first-running-hour wording.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Self-approval          | An explicit labelled demo acknowledgement allows demonstration when submitter and approver are the same identity. The acknowledgement is recorded. This is not a production policy.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Approved correction    | View/history plus a correction-policy explanation; no approved reopening/amendment algorithm is invented.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Older saved approvals  | An approval without captured SMV retains its source rows and history, but reports earned SAH/efficiency as unavailable. No guessed backfill from current style data is performed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Audit context          | New events retain organization dimensions from before/after states and related operational parents. Unknown legacy context fails closed for restricted memberships; tenant-wide administrators retain history access.                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Attendance corrections | Authorized demo attendance managers correct immediately with a required reason and before/after history. Approval/escalation governance is not implied.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Capacity               | Whole order-line quantity × captured SMV; calendar-based available minutes and advisory overload/double-booking warnings. Rescheduling retains factory/order/calendar bindings and captured SMV/manpower/daily-capacity inputs. Dates/lines may move within the original context; different sources or assumptions require a new booking, with the cancelled original retained. Capacity is a planning preview, not a line-balancing optimizer. |
| Procurement            | Award creates a draft PO; issue locks its editable lines. GRN accepts/rejects quantities, received/post/reversal actions retain traceability. Receive/post both recheck the linked issued PO. Cancelled POs cannot produce receipt stock; stale draft GRNs remain cancellable. Posting cannot exceed the remaining ordered accepted quantity.                                                                                                   |
| Inventory              | Manual Opening/Issue/Adjustment/Return entries; Receipt/Reversal entries originate from GRN lifecycle actions. Ledger entries cannot be edited after recording.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Finance                | Customer and supplier invoice drafts, lines, issue and payments. Three-way match is procurement traceability for review, not automated accounting/GL posting. Seed summaries are USD.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| CSV imports            | Buyers, suppliers, materials and employees; templates use accessible IDs. Input tenant/id overrides are ignored, accepted rows persist, failures retain row evidence.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Files                  | Binary content is not retained. A browser file input stores metadata. CSV exports are real browser downloads scoped by the active context.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Integrations           | Illustrative credential references only; sync/webhook runs are simulated history with no external request.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Notifications          | Seed exceptions plus production submission/return generate in-app records/delivery history. Email preferences are illustrative and do not send mail.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Audit                  | App-append-only local records. Reset intentionally replaces the whole demo database. This is not immutable storage against browser tampering.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

## OPEN business decisions

These remain unresolved and are not made definitive by this prototype:

1. Simultaneous assignment of one supervisor to multiple SectionShifts: warnings, no final prohibition.
2. KPI attribution across multiple supervisors on one SectionShift: flagged; ambiguous production components are omitted in the demo.
3. Employee-code uniqueness tenant-wide versus factory-wide: no final uniqueness constraint imposed.
4. Approved ProductionDay correction/reopening workflow: history and a policy explanation only.
5. Self-approval: explicit demo exception acknowledgement, no final authorization rule.
6. Simple quality inputs versus detailed quality taxonomy: only the requested simple inputs.
7. Final QCO business meaning/source: optional reading, no invented source system.
8. Tenant-wide versus factory-specific style identity: factory reference exists; no final style-number uniqueness policy.
9. BuyerOrderLine SKU/size/colour variants: visibly future scope, not modeled.
10. BOM/MRP scope: excluded.
11. Attendance correction approval policy: immediate demo correction with history, governance pending.
12. Multiple attendance segments per day/shift: one demo register row per employee/date/shift; no segmented attendance model.
13. Score configuration governance and approval: editable authorized demo config, immutable snapshots; final approval policy pending.
14. Organization-scope inheritance/precedence: explicit demo scope selector, final combinations/precedence pending.
15. RFQ, supplier PO, GRN and invoice number uniqueness: no final tenant/factory/supplier-wide uniqueness rules.

## Intentionally not implemented

Real authentication/authorization, server APIs, RLS, database constraints, production accounting/payment execution, payroll, GL, BOM/MRP, individual sewing-operator skills, operation-level balancing, detailed unapproved quality classifications, size/colour/SKU architecture, real machine/IoT calls, email/SMS, object/file storage, schema-per-tenant controls, microservices, background workers and production deployment.

The prototype is not a final production schema, authorization engine or accounting system. The existing production scaffold remains unchanged apart from a documentation link.

## Legacy-to-new mapping

| Legacy PMS concept                                  | New ERP demonstration                                                                          |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Manually entered Daily Entry                        | Canonical ProductionDay, with totals derived from hourly children; no second production truth. |
| Independent hourly sheet                            | HourlyOutput child rows of the same ProductionDay.                                             |
| Fixed h1…h10 properties                             | Repeated ordinal-hour records; hours can be added dynamically.                                 |
| Blank hours treated as zero                         | Null means not run; zero is a recorded running hour.                                           |
| Daily staffing P/AB/LV as another attendance source | AttendanceRecord references; staffing does not copy attendance status.                         |
| Production keyed by supervisor                      | Stable line/shift/date identity; responsibility from effective SupervisorAssignment.           |
| Static supervisor ownership                         | Effective-dated SectionShift assignments, roster and retained history.                         |
| Free-text buyer on styles                           | Buyer relational IDs referenced by styles and orders.                                          |
| Independent editable stock balance                  | StockMovement-derived balance.                                                                 |
| Factory treated as company/tenant                   | Tenant company with multiple factories.                                                        |
| Hidden controls used as security                    | Clearly labelled demo checks; production requires backend authorization and RLS.               |
| Overwriting approved/history values                 | Lifecycle locks, correction/reversal records and append-only workflow/audit events.            |
